tool.name: OpenFold3
tool.description: Biomolecular structure prediction model based on AlphaFold3
tool.command:
## Developers: set PLANEMO_TESTING=1 to mock inference (copies canned outputs ## from test-data instead of running the GPU model / calling ColabFold).
## All logging and tracebacks are folded into stdout (2>&1) so the full run ## log appears in the Galaxy "Tool Standard Output".
## Build the OpenFold3 query.json from the structured chain form ------------- python3 '$__tool_directory__/scripts/build_query_json.py' --spec '$chains_spec' --name '$job_name' --use-msa-server '$msa_server' --output query.json 2>&1
## Point OpenFold3 at the admin-populated model/param cache ------------------ && export OPENFOLD_CACHE=\${OPENFOLD_CACHE:-/data/openfold3}
## Run inference (or mock it) ------------------------------------------------ #if os.environ.get('PLANEMO_TESTING') && bash '$__tool_directory__/scripts/mock_openfold.sh' '$job_name' '$__tool_directory__' #if str($advanced.num_model_seeds)# $advanced.num_model_seeds #else# 1 #end if# #if str($advanced.num_diffusion_samples)# $advanced.num_diffusion_samples #else# 5 #end if# 2>&1 #else && run_openfold predict --query-json query.json --output-dir output --use-msa-server $msa_server #if str($advanced.num_diffusion_samples) --num-diffusion-samples $advanced.num_diffusion_samples #end if #if str($advanced.num_model_seeds) --num-model-seeds $advanced.num_model_seeds #end if 2>&1 #end if

param.name: job_name
param.label: Prediction name
param.help: A short name for this job (max 20 characters). Used as the query identifier and in output file names.

validator.message: Use only letters, numbers, underscore and hyphen.
Keep the prediction name to 20 characters or fewer.

repeat.name: chains
repeat.title: Protein chain
repeat.help: Add one entry per protein chain. A single chain models a monomer; multiple chains model a complex (multimer).

param.name: sequence
param.label: Amino acid sequence
param.help: Single-letter amino acid sequence (IUPAC). X for unknown, U for selenocysteine. Whitespace is ignored. Runtime scales steeply with total length.

validator.message: Only amino acid letters (ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY, plus X and U) are allowed.

param.name: msa_server
param.label: Generate MSAs with the ColabFold server
param.help: Uses the public ColabFold MSA server (requires outbound internet on the compute node). This is OpenFold3's default alignment pipeline.

param.label: Diffusion samples per seed
param.help: Number of predicted structures generated per random seed. Leave blank to use the model default (5).

param.label: Model seeds
param.help: Number of random seeds. More seeds broaden sampling at the cost of runtime. Leave blank to use the model default (1).

tool.help:
**OpenFold3** predicts the 3D structure of biomolecules. It is an open-source (Apache 2.0) reproduction of AlphaFold3 by the AlQuraishi Lab at Columbia University and the OpenFold consortium.
-----
**Inputs**
- **Prediction name** — identifier for the job; appears in output file names. - **Protein chain(s)** — add one entry per chain. One chain models a *monomer*; several chains model a *complex (multimer)*. - **ColabFold MSAs** — when enabled (default), multiple sequence alignments are generated via the public ColabFold server.
-----
**Outputs**
- **Predicted structures (mmCIF)** — one structure per diffusion sample. - **Confidence summaries** — complex-level scores (``ptm``, ``iptm``, ranking score, etc.). - **Per-atom confidences** — per-atom ``pLDDT`` / ``PAE`` / ``PDE``.
-----
**Notes**
This wrapper currently supports **protein** chains with ColabFold MSAs. RNA, DNA, ligands, structural templates and precomputed MSAs are planned follow-ups.
A GPU is required for practical runtimes, and model parameters must be pre-staged by the Galaxy administrator into the shared ``$OPENFOLD_CACHE`` directory.
